description: Lower-extremity morphology: leg length, thigh and calf circumference, thigh definition, calf shape, ankle morphology. Splits the original 'Limb' atlas category from the 21-category list into separate arms.json + legs.json files. Knee alignment (genu valgum/varum) is captured in body-shape.json's `knee_alignment` dimension; this file focuses on soft-tissue and silhouette morphology.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with anthropometric descriptors of lower-extremity proportional length, related to but distinct from the trunk_to_leg_ratio dimension in body-shape.json.
dimensions.description: Total leg length (greater trochanter to floor) relative to torso length.

values.definition: Legs appear short relative to torso; high cormic index.
Legs appear long relative to torso; low cormic index.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with anthropometric descriptors of mid-thigh circumference.
dimensions.description: Thigh girth at mid-thigh, qualitative bucket.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with sports-medicine descriptors of quadriceps / hamstring visibility.
dimensions.description: Visible musculature definition in the thigh region.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with body-contouring descriptors of calf morphology.
dimensions.description: Shape of the gastrocnemius / soleus complex visible posteriorly.

values.definition: Pronounced gastrocnemius prominence high on the calf.
Calf prominence sits low on the leg.
Pronounced calf mass with strong taper to ankle.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with anthropometric descriptors of maximum calf circumference.
Aligned with body-contouring descriptors of ankle taper.
dimensions.description: Ankle morphology including taper from calf and malleolar visibility.

values.definition: Pronounced taper from calf to ankle.
Minimal taper; ankle approaches calf circumference.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with body-contouring descriptors of leg-region proportions.
dimensions.description: Relative dominance of thigh versus calf circumference.

values.definition: Calf approaches or exceeds thigh in circumference.

references: Standring S (ed.) (2020). Gray's Anatomy: The Anatomical Basis of Clinical Practice, 42nd Edition. Elsevier.
Eveleth PB, Tanner JM (1990). Worldwide Variation in Human Growth, 2nd Edition. Cambridge University Press.
